title: 繡春刀・黃昏對決
intent: 建立一段古裝武打片，雙方使用繡春刀

style.look: Cinematic Chinese wuxia film, Ming dynasty setting, anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, practical dust and embers, restrained teal-and-amber grade
style.camera: controlled dolly, crane and handheld moves typical of a wuxia duel
style.ambience: wind over ruins, dry leaves scraping stone, distant crows
style.music: low taiko drums and a sparse erhu line that swells at the clash
style.negative: No on-screen text, subtitles, logos or watermarks. Exactly two fighters, no extra people. Each fighter holds exactly one xiuchun dao (a slim, slightly curved single-edged Ming saber). No guns, no modern objects, no deformed hands, no blades bending or melting.

script.body:
EXT. 廢棄驛站庭院 - 黃昏

殘陽穿過斷柱。凌風（飛魚服、繡春刀）與血煞（黑色斗篷、繡春刀）相隔十步對峙，風捲起落葉。

            血煞
      （冷笑）
   錦衣衛的刀，也不過如此。

凌風不答，拇指推開刀鍔。兩人同時衝出，刀鋒相交，火星四濺。凌風側身卸力，反手一刀逼退血煞。血煞怒吼，雙手握刀劈下——凌風最後一刻閃身，刀鋒擦過他的臉頰。

兩人錯身而過，背對背停住。落葉落地。

subjects.name: 凌風
subjects.appearance: Chinese man around 30, lean athletic build, sharp calm eyes, short beard stubble, black hair tied in a topknot under a black gauze cap
subjects.wardrobe: dark indigo Ming-dynasty feiyu robe with gold embroidered flying-fish pattern, black leather belt, leather bracers, one xiuchun dao in a black scabbard on the left hip
subjects.capability_ceiling: elite imperial guard swordsman: fast, precise, economical cuts and parries; human strength and speed only - no flying, no wire-fu leaps, no superhuman feats
subjects.negative_boundary: never taunts or shouts, never attacks a fallen enemy, never fights with wild swings; stays silent and controlled
subjects.linguistic_blueprint: almost wordless; at most a few short calm words
subjects.kinematic_signature: low centered stance, weight on the back foot, blade held close to the body, minimal footwork, sudden explosive bursts then stillness

subjects.name: 血煞
subjects.appearance: Chinese man in his 40s, broad heavy build, scarred left cheek, long unkempt black hair, intense glaring eyes
subjects.wardrobe: torn black hooded cloak over dark red leather armor, wrapped forearms, one xiuchun dao with a red-wrapped handle
subjects.capability_ceiling: brutal veteran fighter: powerful heavy two-handed strikes, slower recovery than Ling Feng; human strength only
subjects.negative_boundary: never retreats willingly, never uses tricks like throwing sand, never begs
subjects.linguistic_blueprint: low gravelly voice, short contemptuous sentences, sneering
subjects.kinematic_signature: wide aggressive stance, shoulders rolled forward, big committed swings from the shoulder, heavy footsteps

environments.name: 廢棄驛站庭院
environments.description: abandoned Ming-dynasty post-station courtyard: cracked stone floor with moss, broken wooden pillars, collapsed tiled roof, scattered dry leaves, tattered banners
environments.light: low golden sunset from camera left, long hard shadows to the right, dust in the light shafts
environments.palette: dark slate blue shadows, warm amber highlights, deep red accents
environments.materials: weathered grey stone, splintered dark wood, aged clay roof tiles

shots.scene: The two fighters face off in the ruined courtyard at sunset
shots.composition: Ling Feng frame left, Xue Sha frame right, ten paces apart, setting sun between them
shots.action: The two men stand still facing each other, leaves blowing between them

dialogue.subject: S2
dialogue.line: 錦衣衛的刀，也不過如此。

shots.focus: Xue Sha's eyes, shallow depth of field
shots.composition: Xue Sha on the right third, looking camera left
shots.action: Xue Sha sneers and speaks his line

shots.composition: hand and scabbard filling the frame
shots.action: Ling Feng's thumb pushes the sword guard, a few centimeters of steel slide out of the scabbard

shots.scene: The clash: both charge, blades meet, Ling Feng deflects and counters
shots.focus: the point where the blades meet
shots.composition: fighters meeting in the center of frame
shots.action: Both charge; their sabers clash in the middle with a burst of sparks

shots.composition: Ling Feng foreground left, Xue Sha stumbling back right
shots.action: Ling Feng turns his body to deflect the blow and answers with one backhand cut that drives Xue Sha back two steps

shots.scene: Xue Sha's final heavy strike; Ling Feng slips past it at the last moment; they end back to back
shots.composition: centered, blade raised above his head
shots.action: Xue Sha roars and raises his saber with both hands for an overhead strike

shots.focus: Ling Feng's face as the blade passes
shots.composition: Xue Sha's blade crossing frame right to left past Ling Feng's cheek
shots.action: The blade comes down; Ling Feng slips sideways at the last instant, the edge passing a finger's width from his cheek

shots.composition: the two men back to back in the center, long shadows, leaves settling
shots.action: The two fighters stand back to back after passing each other, completely still, leaves settling on the stones
shots.music: a single erhu note fading out
